  3928: function accessAccountRole(account){
  3929:   if(String(account?.admin||'').toUpperCase()==='Y')return '관리자';
  3930:   const role=String(account?.role||'').trim();
  3931:   if(/학년부장/.test(role))return '학년부장';
  3932:   if(/학년총무/.test(role))return '학년총무';
  3933:   if(/담임/.test(role))return '담임교사';
  3934:   if(/교감/.test(role))return '교감';
  3935:   if(/교장/.test(role))return '교장';
  3936:   return '교과담당';
  3937: }

  4421: function fiveGradeBoundaryData(enrollment) {
  4422:   const total = Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(enrollment) || 1));
  4423:   const cumulativeRates = [0.10, 0.34, 0.66, 0.90, 1];

  4425:   cumulative[cumulative.length - 1] = total;
  4426:   const counts = cumulative.map((value, index) => value - (index ? cumulative[index - 1] : 0));
  4427:   return { total, cumulative, counts };

  8727: function parseReferencePaste(text, type) {
  8728:   const headers = {
  8729:     approval: ["업무분류", "업무 종류", "결재라인", "비고"],
  8730:     homeroom: ["학년", "반", "담임", "부담임"],
  8731:     extension: ["구역", "이름", "시설", "자리", "대표번호", "내선"],
  8732:   }[type] || [];
  8733:   const widths = { approval: 3, homeroom: 4, extension: 4 };
  8734:   return String(text || "").split(/\r?\n/).map((line) => {
  8735:     const cells = (line.includes("\t") ? line.split("\t") : line.split(/\s{2,}|,/))
  8736:       .map((cell) => String(cell || "").trim());
  8737:     while (cells.length && !cells[cells.length - 1]) cells.pop();
  8738:     return cells.slice(0, widths[type] || cells.length);
  8739:   }).filter((row) => {
  8740:     const joined = row.join(" ");
  8741:     return row.filter(Boolean).length >= 2 && !headers.some((header) => joined === header || joined.startsWith(`${header} `));
  8742:   });
------
  8727: function parseReferencePaste(text, type) {
  8728:   const headers = {
  8729:     approval: ["업무분류", "업무 종류", "결재라인", "비고"],
  8730:     homeroom: ["학년", "반", "담임", "부담임"],
  8731:     extension: ["구역", "이름", "시설", "자리", "대표번호", "내선"],
  8732:   }[type] || [];
  8733:   const widths = { approval: 3, homeroom: 4, extension: 4 };
  8734:   return String(text || "").split(/\r?\n/).map((line) => {
  8735:     const cells = (line.includes("\t") ? line.split("\t") : line.split(/\s{2,}|,/))
  8736:       .map((cell) => String(cell || "").trim());
  8737:     while (cells.length && !cells[cells.length - 1]) cells.pop();
  8738:     return cells.slice(0, widths[type] || cells.length);
  8739:   }).filter((row) => {
  8740:     const joined = row.join(" ");
  8741:     return row.filter(Boolean).length >= 2 && !headers.some((header) => joined === header || joined.startsWith(`${header} `));
  8742:   });
  8743: }

 10804: function normalizeAfterAttendanceStatus(value){
 10805:   const text=String(value||"").trim();
 10806:   if(/불참\(인정\)|공결|공식 ?행사|인정/.test(text))return "불참(인정)";
 10807:   if(/불참\(조퇴\)|조퇴/.test(text))return "불참(조퇴)";
------
 10808:   if(/불참\(결석\)|병결|결석/.test(text))return "불참(결석)";
 10809:   if(/불참\(미인정\)|미인정|무단|불참/.test(text))return "불참(미인정)";
 10810:   if(/수강|출석|참여|정상|입실|지각/.test(text))return "수강";
 10811:   return "신청";
 10812: }
 10813: function afterAttendanceOverrideKey(program,student){
 10814:   return [program.sessionId||program.id||"",student.studentId||student.studentNo||student.number||student.name||""].join("|");
 10815: }
 10816: function resolvedAfterAttendanceStatus(program,student){
 10817:   const key=afterAttendanceOverrideKey(program,student);
 10818:   return state.afterAttendanceOverrides?.[key]||normalizeAfterAttendanceStatus(student.attendance||student.result||student.participation);
 10819: }
 10820: const AFTER_ATTENDANCE_STATUSES=["신청","수강","불참(미인정)","불참(결석)","불참(조퇴)","불참(인정)"];

 10822: function openAfterschoolProgramDrawer(id) {
 10823:   const sourceProgram = [...afterSchoolProgramGroups(),...groupedAfterSchoolCourses(afterSchoolProgramGroups())].find((item) => item.id === id);
 10824:   const program = programWithOverride(sourceProgram);
 10825:   if (!program) return;
 10826:   const students = (program.students || []).slice().sort((a,b)=>Number(programStudentGrade(a))-Number(programStudentGrade(b))||Number(a.className)-Number(b.className)||Number(String(a.studentNo||"").slice(-2))-Number(String(b.studentNo||"").slice(-2)));
------
 10826:   const students = (program.students || []).slice().sort((a,b)=>Number(programStudentGrade(a))-Number(programStudentGrade(b))||Number(a.className)-Number(b.className)||Number(String(a.studentNo||"").slice(-2))-Number(String(b.studentNo||"").slice(-2)));
 10827:   const statusCounts=Object.fromEntries(AFTER_ATTENDANCE_STATUSES.map(status=>[status,0]));
 10828:   students.forEach(student=>{const status=resolvedAfterAttendanceStatus(program,student);statusCounts[status]=(statusCounts[status]||0)+1;});
 10829:   const statusSummary=AFTER_ATTENDANCE_STATUSES.map(status=>`<span class="after-status-kpi"><b>${escapeHtml(status)}</b><em>${statusCounts[status]||0}</em></span>`).join("");

 11357: function openDormOutingTeacherEditor(){
 11358:   const all=readonlyCache?.students||[], dorm=readonlyCache?.dormStudents||[];
